title: Recorded test run
responsibility: Displays one side of grouped test outcomes and their artifacts.

inputs.name: EntityRun.shown
inputs.description: Required grouped behavior/scenario data. Overall passes only with at least one group and every selected-side group passing.

inputs.name: EntityRun.side
inputs.description: Required before or after, selecting each group/line outcome. After alone displays difference paths.

inputs.name: EntityRun.title
inputs.description: Required pane heading and accessible name.

inputs.name: EntityRun.mediaBase
inputs.description: Required artifact URL base passed to result viewers.

inputs.name: EntityRun.lost
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default, telling artifacts that reading failed rather than remains pending.

inputs.name: EntityRun.unit
inputs.description: Optional function identifier passed through to callable case rows.

outputs.name: EntityRun
outputs.description: Run pane with overall/state verdicts, scenario/state names, result kinds and Passed/Failed/Not recorded labels. Shows supplied artifacts and after-side differences without calculating new verification.
